title: Entered a fake birthday on Instagram? Meta's AI can now identify users posing as adults
snippet: Meta is expanding its AI-powered age-detection technology globally to identify teenagers who use fake birth dates to appear as adults on Instagram. The move will place more users aged 13 to 17 under Teen Account safety settings, while Meta is also introducing Apple's age-range signal in Australia.

title: GTA 6 release date confirmed for November 19: Pre-load, New Zealand early access, PC update and £1 million car
snippet: Rockstar Games has confirmed November 19, 2026, as the GTA 6 release date, with digital pre-loading starting November 10 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Ahead of launch, reports detail New Zealand's early access, the unconfirmed PC version and a real-life GTA-inspired Grotti Cheetah.

title: Apple introduces $50 AI usage packs for Creator Studio apps: What users get and how they work
snippet: Apple has introduced $49.99 one-time AI usage packs for Creator Studio subscribers who exhaust their free monthly limits, starting with Logic Pro. Available in India and seven other countries, the packs offer 12-month validity.

title: OpenAI to discontinue old ChatGPT voice modes from Dec 11; users to shift to live voice mode
snippet: OpenAI will discontinue the Advanced and Standard voice options in ChatGPT from December 11 this year, moving users to its newer Live voice mode as the company looks to simplify the voice experience and focus on improving its latest technology.

snippet: Spain's government has demanded that TikTok suspend its operations in Spain until it eliminates child sexual abuse material, it said on Tuesday, after a media report documented 1,183 explicit posts on the platform with millions of views.
